a.description: array_like Tensor to 'invert'. Its shape must be 'square', i. e., ``prod(a.shape[:ind]) == prod(a.shape[ind:])``.
constraints: a is singular or not 'square' -> b shape error

ind.description: int, optional Number of first indices that are involved in the inverse sum. Must be a positive integer, default is 2.

constraints: a is singular or not 'square' -> b shape error
